reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of soft ferromagnetism in prior FeCoNiPd/Pt alloys by proposing a physically sound mechanism (enhanced spin–orbit coupling and lattice distortion from Ir) to increase coercivity, and it provides a specific, testable experiment with a clear falsification rule. Hypothesis B uses an inappropriate baseline (pure FeCoNi instead of the prior high-entropy derivatives) and relies on a mechanism (twin boundary pinning from Mn) that is less directly tied to the stated problem of soft magnetism in the Pd/Pt alloys, making it less targeted and less convincing
